name: Jason M.
body: Really happy with my hat! Went for the green and it’s even nicer in person. Lives in my gym bag now.

name: Lauren
body: My husband laughed when I ordered these. He now reminds me to pack his before we leave for the gym 😂

name: Nandi K.
body: Love that I can fit all my hair underneath without having to squash it down. Very comfy and the cream is gorgeous.

name: Pieter
body: Bought one for myself and one for my dad. He’s quite difficult to buy for so was very pleased when he actually started using it!

name: Craig S.
body: Great quality. Felt a bit firm out the box but has softened nicely with use. Happy with my purchase.

name: Megan
body: The little note in the parcel was lovely. You can tell there are actual people behind this business who care about what they’re sending out. Thanks guys xx

name: Sipho
body: Wasn’t sure how often I’d use it but I’ve taken it to every sauna session since it arrived. My head feels much more comfortable with it on.

name: Carla V.
body: Green was definitely the right choice. Such a nice deep colour and the embroidery looks really neat.

name: Brendan
body: We got one of each colour and I thought we’d share. Apparently the cream one is now my wife’s and I’m not allowed to touch it.

name: Ayesha
body: Very happy! Plenty of room for my hair and doesn’t feel tight around my head. Have already sent the link to my sister.

name: Daniel P.
body: First sauna hat I’ve owned so nothing to compare it to, but I’m enjoying it. Easy enough to pop in my bag with my towel.

name: Nicole
body: Bought this as a gift and ended up wanting one myself when I saw it. Next order will be for me 😊

name: Zanele
body: My hair usually feels quite dry after the sauna. Seems a bit happier since I started wearing this, so I’ll be keeping it in my routine.

name: Willem B.
body: Lovely hat, fits well. I have quite a big head and was expecting it to be a squeeze but there’s loads of room.

name: Robyn
body: Got a few questions about it at the gym this morning. Let my friend try it and then had to ask for it back!

name: Leanne
body: Love my cream hat! Was worried I’d regret choosing a light colour but it’s so pretty. Just have to stop leaving it at the bottom of my bag.

name: Johan & Anika
body: Ordered for our sauna at home. Both getting used regularly and still looking good. Would happily recommend.

name: Yusuf D.
body: The wool feels substantial and the stitching is tidy. Pleased with it, especially having only seen pictures before ordering.

name: Greg
body: I do look slightly ridiculous wearing it but I’ve made peace with that. Very comfortable sauna sessions since getting mine 😂

name: Lindiwe
body: Really lovely to buy from a small South African business. Had a question before ordering and got a helpful reply. Thank you!

name: Kyle
body: My mom has claimed mine so I suppose that’s a good review. Will have to order another.

name: Kayleigh
body: Fits over my bun which was my main concern. Don’t have to redo my hair just to put the hat on. Love it!

name: Anton R.
body: Been using mine a few times a week. Takes up hardly any space with my gym things and I miss it when I forget it at home.

name: Jenna
body: Bought the green for my boyfriend. He sent me a selfie wearing it before he’d even left the house. Safe to say he likes it.

name: Chantal
body: Such a sweet parcel to receive. Put the hat on immediately and walked around the kitchen in it. Haven’t been this excited about a gym purchase in ages xx
